chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about combining the maghrib and the later 'isha' at Jam', so he said: Do not perform them until you reach Jam', even if as much of the night as has passed should pass. For indeed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, combined them with one adhan and two iqamahs, just as he combined the zuhr and the 'asr at 'Arafat.

key_terms.بِأَذَانٍ وَاحِدٍ: with a single call to prayer

ai.seo_question: Can maghrib and 'isha' be delayed and combined at Jam' during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the timing of salat during hajj rites, specifically delaying maghrib and 'isha' until reaching Jam' on the night of al-nahr. It also cites the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as the basis, mentioning one adhan and two iqamahs for the combined prayers.
